faq.a: Shabbir is associated with the Arabic form شَبِّير, whose core sense is shabbir; a male given name.

faq.q: What is the origin of Shabbir?
faq.a: Shabbir is associated with Arabic. Shabbir is Arabic شَبِّير (Shabbīr), a name traditionally associated with the Prophet's grandson al-Hasan.
Yes — the underlying form شَبِّير is Arabic.
Shabbir can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Shabbir should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Shabbīr is not a Quranic personal name.
